statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-28155 is an SSRF mitigation bypass in the deprecated request package (no longer maintained). The package allows cross-protocol redirects (HTTP to HTTPS or vice versa) that can bypass SSRF protections. The maintainers have deprecated the package and recommend migrating to alternatives. Trigger.dev uses request as a transitive dependency; direct migration requires upstream changes. Investigating whether the vulnerable code paths are reachable in the application's usage patterns and evaluating migration options.
